rulings.description: Empty single-use 2.5-gallon HDPE plastic jugs with polypropylene screw caps and dispensing closures, to be filled with car-wash chemicals for sale.
rulings.note: Capacity over 50 ml so not 3923.30.0010.

rulings.description: Three-piece stackable ABS plastic food storage container with a compartmented platter and lid, held together by a silicone strap, with two silicone-tipped metal tongs; for storing and carrying food.
Cat toy set: molded polypropylene spring-loaded launcher shaped like a gun plus fifty polyester pom pom balls, packaged together for retail and marketed for domestic cats.
rulings.note: Pet toys are excluded from 9503 by Ch. 95 Note; plastic pet toys are household articles of plastics (3924).

rulings.description: Shoe trees / shoe forms made of 100% molded ABS plastic, shaped like the front of a shoe with ventilation holes, inserted into footwear when not worn; sold in packs of pairs.
rulings.note: Not footwear parts (6406) and not 3926; household article of plastics (3924).

rulings.description: 28 oz plastic shaker bottle (polypropylene body, polyethylene screw-on lid with spout) with a removable stainless steel wire mixing ball, for mixing protein shakes and smoothies.
rulings.note: Composite good; plastic bottle gives essential character under GRI 3(b).

rulings.description: Small handbag made entirely of injection-molded plastic with molded plastic top handles and a metal zipper closure, for carrying keys, cosmetics or a phone.
rulings.note: Close call: molded plastic is not a named outer-surface material for handbags in heading 4202, so falls to 3926.

rulings.description: Men's faux leather jacket with an outer shell of cellular polyurethane plastic backed by woven polyester fabric present only for reinforcement; quilted polyester lining, sherpa collar, full zipper.
rulings.note: Close call textile vs plastic: fabric is merely reinforcing the cellular plastic (Ch. 59 Note 2(a)(5)), so apparel of plastics, not 6210.

rulings.description: Disc-shaped impact-absorbing pads made predominantly of thermoplastic elastomer with a barrier film and fluid medium, for incorporation into protective sporting equipment such as helmets.
Insulated backpack cooler bag with thermoplastic elastomer (plastic) outer surface and foam insulation, multiple insulated compartments and pockets, imported with two ice packs.
rulings.note: Composite good; the insulated bag gives essential character over the ice packs.

rulings.description: Card holder for up to three cards: rigid polycarbonate frame wrapped in bovine leather with embedded magnets that attach it to the back of a MagSafe-compatible iPhone.
rulings.note: Close call: importer proposed 8517.62; CBP held the purpose of purchase is carrying cards, so a leather pocket article of 4202.31.

rulings.description: Child's backpack with outer surface of 100% polyester textile and two shoulder straps, sized to carry a child's personal effects.
Women's handbags and framed clutches with outer surface of bovine leather (kiss-lock frames, chain shoulder strap or fringe flap), valued over $20 each.
rulings.note: Same ruling: identical bags valued not over $20 go to 4202.21.6000; value drives the 8-digit split.

rulings.description: Novelty phone wallets in duck and avocado shapes with outer surface of man-made textile, attached to the back of a phone by an adhesive magnetic ring, for carrying cards, cash and small items.
rulings.note: Not a toy of 9503: Ch. 95 Note 1(d) excludes containers of heading 4202.

rulings.description: Wheeled laundry tote bag with outer surface of plastic sheeting, inner foam, zipper closure, three handles and four casters, about 18 x 14 x 24 inches.
rulings.note: Importer proposed 9403 furniture; rejected as bags are more specifically provided for in 4202.

rulings.description: Fitted carrying case of man-made textile material designed to hold, protect and transport a CPAP sleep therapy machine and its humidifier, power supply, tubing and mask.

Men's jacket with outer shell of 100% polyester knit fabric, lined with polyurethane-coated woven polyester quilted to nonwoven batting; full zipper front, pointed collar, long sleeves, patch pockets.
rulings.note: Classified on the knit outer shell, not the coated lining, so not 6113; Chapter 61 has no water-resistance provision.

rulings.description: Women's suit-type jacket of 100% polyester knit fabric, four panels, full button front, spread collar, long sleeves, patch pockets, fully lined with woven polyester.
Women's pajama top and pajama pants of 95% polyester/5% elastane knit fabric, button-front top with notched collar and drawstring-waist pants, sold as sleepwear.
Women's knit zip-front 'bomber' style top of 96% cotton/4% spandex, rib knit collar, cuffs and bottom band that does not tighten, zip pockets, lined with woven polyester.
rulings.note: Close call jacket vs sweater: lacks outerwear character, so classified as a sweater/pullover-type garment of 6110 instead of 6102.

rulings.description: Women's crew-neck knit sweater, 64% acrylic/30% polyester/4% metallic/2% spandex, fewer than nine stitches per 2 cm, rib knit cuffs and bottom band.
rulings.note: Lab analysis of the metalized yarn under Section XI Note 2 still left man-made fibers as chief weight.

rulings.description: Girls' single-leg athletic compression legging of 78% polyester/22% spandex knit, elastic waistband, one full-length leg and one short side, sold as sportswear.
rulings.note: No engineered compression or medical support, so treated as an ordinary athletic garment of 6114.

rulings.description: Multi-purpose gloves of 100% polyester knit fabric with a thermoplastic polyurethane membrane laminated inside, with fourchettes and elastic wrist; 50% or more textile by weight.

Men's hooded jacket combining 100% polyamide woven fabric (hood, sleeves, shoulders, back yoke; hood and sleeves zip off) with 82% polyester/18% elastane knit body; full zipper front, thumb-hole cuffs, zip pockets.
rulings.note: Close call knit vs woven: neither fabric exceeds 60% of visible surface or gives essential character, so GRI 3(c) last heading (6201).

rulings.description: Women's trousers of 98% cotton/2% spandex woven fabric with flat waistband, hook-and-loop front fly, belt loops, front inset pockets, coin pocket and rear patch pockets.

Girls' school-uniform one-piece dress: woven 55% cotton/45% polyester shirt top with collar, sewn-on rib-knit cotton/polyester sleeveless overlay, and 100% polyester woven pleated skirt; shoulder to mid-thigh.
rulings.note: Close call knit vs woven: neither component gives essential character, GRI 3(c) last heading (6204) over 6104.

rulings.description: Men's long-sleeve shirt of 100% cotton yarn-dyed woven flannel (napped) fabric, button-down collar, partial functional button front, hook-and-loop back opening for wheelchair users, chest patch pocket.
Unisex pullover medical scrub top of 65% polyester/35% cotton woven fabric with V-neck, short sleeves, chest pocket and side vents, designed for hospital and clinic use.

Cotton sheet set for retail sale (flat sheet, fitted sheet, pillowcases, self-fabric bag) of 100% cotton dyed woven fabric, not napped; flat sheet and pillowcases have a cuff with an inserted openwork polyester embroidery trim.
rulings.note: Set under GRI 3(b)/GRI 6; the embroidered pieces give essential character, so the 'containing embroidery/lace' sheet subheading applies.

rulings.description: Decorative 18 x 18 inch pillow cover (no filling) of 100% polyester woven fabric, printed face and back, envelope closure.

Electric heating pad worn as a cape over the shoulders, neck and back: polyester knit plush outer shells with nonwoven polyester layers bonded to heating wire, snap closures and tie strap, detachable controller with temperature and timer settings.
rulings.note: Close call: suggested 8516.79 rejected because Ch. 85 Note 1(a) excludes electrically warmed articles worn on or about the person; falls to textile made-up articles.

rulings.description: Quilted furniture moving blanket, 72 x 80 inches: polyester/cotton nonwoven felt batting between two layers of dyed polyester woven fabric, edges bound with polyester tape; used to protect furniture during moves.
rulings.note: Not a blanket of 6301 (not for protection against cold) and not quilted piece goods of 5811 (it is made up).

rulings.description: Women's slip-on garden clog, closed toe and open heel, not covering the ankle; upper and outer sole of molded rubber/plastics joined by vulcanizing or cementing, textile collar trim, outsole tread ribs with a leather application on most of the surface but not on the ground-contacting ribs.
rulings.note: Leather is largely absent from the tread that touches the ground, so the outsole is rubber/plastics: waterproof footwear of 6401 rather than 6405.

rulings.description: Men's below-the-ankle golf shoe with zippered shroud upper predominantly of TPU rubber/plastics over mesh, molded rubber/plastic outsole with turf-gripping protrusions over 1/4 inch, valued over $40/pair.
Women's casual flat shoe not covering the ankle, upper over 90% rubber/plastics with a thin elastic lace that ties around the lower leg, 100% rubber/plastics outsole, no foxing band.

Below-the-ankle athletic training shoes with textile uppers covered mostly by 3D-printed rubber/plastic overlays (majority of external surface), rubber/plastic traction outsole with foxing-like band, valued over $12/pair.
rulings.note: Close call textile vs plastic upper: small textile areas enclosed by plastic lines are counted as filled-in plastic, so not 6404.

rulings.description: Women's open-toe, open-heel slip-on flat mule sandal with two leather straps and leather disc on the vamp, leather outer sole, stacked leather heel with rubber heel cap.

Women's lightweight lace-up athletic sneaker, below the ankle, predominantly textile upper, rubber/plastics traction outsole with foxing-like band, padded collar and tongue, two small rhinestones on the side; over $12/pair.
rulings.note: Close call athletic vs non-athletic: small rhinestones do not prevent classification as athletic footwear.

rulings.description: Unisex open-back house slipper with padded sherpa-like polyester textile upper decorated as a pumpkin; thin rubber/plastics outsole with embedded textile threads visible on the ground-contact surface.
rulings.note: Embedded textile on the sole is durable, so not 6404.19.37; classified under 'other footwear' with textile uppers, house slippers.

rulings.description: Men's insulated above-the-ankle waterproof boot with upper primarily of rubber/plastics and a lugged rubber outsole thickly covered with leather flocking over most of the ground-contact surface.
rulings.note: Leather flocking makes the outsole material 'other than rubber/plastics', moving the boot to 6405.

rulings.description: Men's leather casual boot upper, lasted and sewn to a midsole, with a nickel-sized or larger hole punched through the bottom; outsole to be attached after importation.
rulings.note: Open bottom makes it an unformed upper (6406.10) rather than formed footwear.

rulings.description: Corrugated alloy steel plate (SI-Steel grade 500B400) cut into sheets and formed into a ribbed/angular ladder-type corrugation, 680 x 655 mm, 0.5 mm thick.
rulings.note: Corrugated profile makes it an angle/shape/section of other alloy steel rather than flat-rolled product.

rulings.description: Steel tubes 243 inches long, 1.25 inch outside diameter, swaged at one end so tubes nest together and drilled with four holes, for use as fence posts in livestock fencing.
rulings.note: Tubes prepared for use in structures (7308).

rulings.description: 1/4 x 1-1/2 inch zinc-plated low carbon steel hanger bolt: headless, lag-screw thread and point on one end, machine thread and hex drive on the other, threaded over more than 25% of its length.
rulings.note: Headless double-threaded article treated as a stud.

rulings.description: M42 x 1.5 stainless steel internally threaded hex locknut designed to resist loosening under vibration or load.
Fully threaded stainless steel pan head thread-forming screw with 6-lobe Torx drive, 1 mm diameter x 4 mm long, used to fasten a circuit board in a headset control box.

Zinc-plated steel threaded mounting stud with conical head, internal hex-drive socket, shoulder collar and 5/16-18 UNC threaded shank, torqued into a refrigerator door to secure the handle; made to OEM drawing.
rulings.note: Threaded fastener of 7318 is a part of general use (Section XV Note 2), so classified there despite its specialized appliance function.

rulings.description: Zinc-plated steel headless unthreaded hinge pin, about 3.2 inches long, serving as the pivot axle for the tilt-head of a household stand mixer.
rulings.note: Close call: importer proposed 8509 mixer part; as a 7318 part of general use it is excluded from Section XVI parts by Note 1(g).

rulings.description: Conical-seat wheel lug nut: zinc-nickel plated steel internally threaded nut body with a tapered seat permanently assembled with a domed steel hex cap, used to secure road wheels to vehicle wheel studs.
Stainless steel milk frothing jug with spout and handle and a plastic thermometer indicator strip on the outside, used to steam and pour milk for coffee.
rulings.note: Milk jugs are named eo nomine in heading 7323 as household/tableware articles of steel.

rulings.description: Cookware set for home cooking: two round raw carbon steel frying pans (uncoated) with one detachable forged aluminum handle, a leather protective pad and a tin of pan maintenance paste, sold together.
rulings.note: Set under GRI 3(b); the steel pan gives essential character, classified as steel cookingware.

rulings.description: Portable folding reading stand of a stainless steel base plate hinged to a stainless steel support arm that slides into the spine sleeve of a special book cover to hold a book at an angle.
rulings.note: Close call: rejected 8304 office/desk equipment (not for holding desk articles); falls to residual 7326.

rulings.description: Cordless battery-powered robotic swimming pool cleaner that crawls the pool floor and walls and pumps pool water through internal filter baskets to trap debris, silt and algae before returning filtered water to the pool.

56-volt walk-behind power head for garden attachments: wheeled chassis, handles with trigger switches, brushless DC motor and gearbox that drives interchangeable outdoor implements; imported without battery, charger or attachments.
Touchscreen seatback display unit for commercial airliners with built-in CPU, memory, storage, Wi-Fi and Android OS that can run any installed apps, games and video; functions as a tablet computer.
rulings.note: Programmable general-purpose device with CPU, input and output in one housing = ADP machine.

rulings.description: Battery-powered hand-held electric seed spreader with a one-gallon hopper and motor-driven impeller for broadcasting seed, fertilizer and pesticide granules on lawns and gardens; imported without battery or charger.

Battery-powered professional rodent snap trap with a spring-loaded metal strike mechanism, proximity sensor, electronic release, and built-in cellular module that reports trap status to a remote server.
rulings.note: Mechanical trapping is the principal function; the sensor and cellular reporting only support it.

rulings.description: Multi-phase AC electric motor (stator, rotor, output shaft and bearings, no gearing) with 42.5 kW maximum output, for mating to submersible wastewater pumps; imported without the pump.

Wall-mount battery charger for lithium-ion batteries used in aviation headsets; contains a transformer, rectifier, voltage regulator, capacitors and filters in a plastic housing. Imported without the battery.
Lithium-ion power bank in a compact rectangular case with two USB-C and two USB-A ports and LED indicators, 26,800 mAh nominal capacity, 128 W max combined output, used to charge portable devices.

Wireless TV speaker system: a transmitter/charging base that connects to a television and an amplified wireless speaker module containing two loudspeakers in one enclosure, with volume dial, tone selector and headphone jack.
Retrofit headset kit for aviation helmets: two ear-cup speakers with microphones, cable harness and wired control box, imported together to form a noise-cancelling aviation headset.

LED status light bar assembly (stainless steel housing, polycarbonate diffuser, PCB with RGB LED chips) installed in a dental milling machine to show machine status through colored and patterned light signals.
rulings.note: Status light with LEDs classified as an indicator panel of electric visual signaling apparatus (8531).

rulings.description: Air pressure switch for an HVAC system: a diaphragm and spring in an enclosure with electrical connectors that closes the electrical contacts when air flow pressure is correct and opens the circuit otherwise.
rulings.note: CROSS index lists 8536.90.5065 but the ruling text assigns 8536.50.9065 ('Other switches'); text used.

rulings.description: LED lamp boards, each with 210 LED diodes on sheet metal and a two-prong connector, used as the light source in hydroponic growing systems inside freight containers, connected to separate LED drivers.
rulings.note: Corrects N337034, which had cited obsolete 8539.50.0090.

rulings.description: Dual N-channel/P-channel MOSFET transistors in a 6-pin TSOT26 package for automotive backlighting and DC-DC power management; 1 MHz operating frequency, max power dissipation 1.1 W, supplied on reels.
Electrical battery jumper and ground jumper cables for commercial trucks and trailers, each a single insulated wire with terminal rings or a female connector on the ends, for under 1,000 V.
rulings.note: Not a 'wiring set' (8544.30) because they are single cables, not a grouped system of wires for a vehicle.

rulings.description: New electric four-wheel all-terrain vehicle (ATV) for one rider with straddle seat and handlebars, powered only by an electric motor, 2WD/4WD, cargo racks, winch and towing capability, for use on farms and ranches.
rulings.note: Vehicle for transport of persons with only electric propulsion; agricultural actual-use 9817.00.50 unavailable for Ch. 87 vehicles.

rulings.description: Passenger vehicle suspension control arm consisting of a stamped and welded steel arm body, ball joint assembly and rubber boot, connecting the wheel to the vehicle body.
Hitch-mounted bicycle carrier racks of aluminum and stainless steel that plug into a 2-inch trailer hitch receiver on a passenger vehicle to transport bicycles.
rulings.note: Close call: not bicycle parts/accessories of 8714 because they are installed on the motor vehicle; accessory of motor vehicles (8708).

rulings.description: Brake pad shims of nitrile rubber, galvanized steel and silicone adhesive, affixed to motor vehicle disc brake pads to reduce brake noise and correct small imperfections.
Stainless steel exterior sun visor for a heavy-duty truck cab, mounted above the windshield, with integrated decorative LED lights not tied to signaling functions.
rulings.note: Lighting is auxiliary/decorative; classified as a body/cab accessory.

rulings.description: Electric bicycle with pedal assist (one version also with throttle for full self-propulsion), 250-watt brushless motor, 27-37 mile range, max speed 15.5 mph.
rulings.note: Same ruling classifies 350 W electric kick scooters in 8711.60.0090; only the 250 W e-bike is recorded here.
rulings.scheduleNote: 8711.60.0060 is not in the 2026 schedule (statistical split since the 2024 ruling); score the heading only.

rulings.description: Children's electric balance motorcycle without pedals, 400 W max, top speed 13 mph, 6-7 mile range, max rider weight 120 lbs, for ages 5 and up.
rulings.note: Close call: importer proposed 9503 wheeled toy; rejected because it requires acquired skill, reaches 13 mph and carries meaningful injury risk.

rulings.description: Bicycle wheelset for road or mountain bikes (not e-bikes): two wheels with carbon fiber rims, aluminum alloy hubs and polyester fiber rope spokes.
Children's tracing projector art set: small plastic projector light with two rotating image disks that project cartoon characters onto paper, plus a tracing marker and paper sheets.
rulings.note: Close call: importer proposed 9503 toy; projection function is specifically provided for in heading 9008.

rulings.description: High-content confocal imaging microscope system for live-cell research with spinning Nipkow disk confocal scanner, multiple lasers, sCMOS cameras, motorized stage and objective turret, incubator and control workstation.

3x21 fixed-magnification telescopic magnifier in an aluminum housing, no reticle, not for infrared, with diopter focus and elevation/windage adjustment, mounted on a rifle rail behind a red dot or holographic sight to magnify the aiming point.
rulings.note: Close call: importer proposed 9013.80 other optical appliances; CBP found it a telescopic sight for rifles (9013.10).

rulings.description: Liquid-damped magnetic navigator compass for light aircraft, gliders and microlights, with magnet correction system, expansion bellows and adjustable mounting bracket; LED dial lighting only.
rulings.note: Mechanical direction-finding compass; LED illumination does not make it an electrical device.

rulings.description: Dental loupes: wearable binocular magnifying glasses designed and marketed for dentists and hygienists to magnify the treatment area during procedures.
Digital clinical thermometer for oral, rectal or underarm use with backlit LED display, reading in about ten seconds, with rectal stopper.
Wrist-worn optical (PPG) heart rate monitor with plastic housing, display, rechargeable battery and Bluetooth to sync data to a smart device app for fitness classes; no phone notifications.
rulings.note: Close call: importer proposed 8517; Bluetooth transmission is secondary to the measuring function, so Chapter 90.

rulings.description: Remote monitoring units and data loggers for pipeline cathodic protection that measure AC/DC voltage and current (pipe-to-soil potentials), record the values and send them via cellular, satellite or Bluetooth to a cloud platform.
Wrist-worn wearable health band with plastic housing and strap, PPG heart rate sensor, skin and ambient temperature sensors, accelerometer and Bluetooth LE to send data to a phone.
rulings.note: Close call: not 8517 (transmission is secondary); heart rate (9029), temperature (9025) and accelerometer (9031) functions merit equal consideration, so GRI 3(c) last heading, 9031.

rulings.description: Collapsible outdoor camping/beach chairs with steel or aluminum frames and polyester textile seat and back, folding into a carry bag (including a two-seat model with attached storage compartment and umbrella).
rulings.note: Composite goods; metal frame and textile seating give essential character, so outdoor metal-frame seat with textile seating.

rulings.description: Household power-reclining upholstered sectional sofa and its individual components (recliners, armless chairs, corner, console with USB) with wooden frames, S-springs, foam and textile upholstery; not convertible into a bed.
Household upholstered dining chairs with wooden (rubberwood/solid wood) frames; seat and backrest of foam covered in synthetic leather or polyester fabric; shipped two per carton for retail.
rulings.note: Seats of heading 9401 are more specific than other furniture of 9403.

rulings.description: Combination travel backpack/shoulder bag of Cordura textile and leather with laptop compartment and a built-in fold-out padded seat with fiberglass-rod-supported backrest for picnics, camping and events.
rulings.note: Close call bag (4202) vs seat (9401): neither gives essential character, so GRI 3(c) last heading, 9401.

rulings.description: Collapsible floor-standing toy storage chest made of two layers of nonwoven polypropylene textile with a cardboard insert, Velcro lid and fabric handles, about 29 x 14.5 x 16 inches.
rulings.note: Close call: importer proposed 6307 (made-up textile article) but it is movable floor-standing furniture of heading 9403.

rulings.description: Decorative stuffed pillows shaped like a dog or cat, polyester woven pile shell printed with a Day of the Dead skeleton motif, filled with polyester fiber, sold around the holiday.
rulings.note: Close call: festive articles of 9505 rejected because the pillows are utilitarian (Ch. 95 Note 1(x)).

rulings.description: King-size comforter set for retail sale: polyester-fiberfill comforter with 100% cotton jacquard woven face and cotton back, two unstuffed cotton pillow shams, packed in a reusable fabric bag; no embroidery, lace or trim.
rulings.note: Set for retail sale under GRI 3(b); the comforter gives essential character.

rulings.description: Outdoor landscape lighting fixtures: stainless steel surface-mount spotlight, brass path light on an extendable post, and aluminum bullet spotlight on a stake, using MR16/G4 lamps (not included).
Household electric candle warmer desk lamp made of iron, with a round base and cylindrical shade holding a 35 W halogen bulb whose heat melts a candle placed on the base; includes dimmer on cord.

Handmade cylindrical pendant lampshade with metal frame and fitter ring and decorative panels of linen, woven suede leather and natural-fiber mesh; fitted to a separately supplied pendant light and cannot produce light itself.
rulings.note: Part of a luminaire (9405.99).

rulings.description: Plastic toy guns that shoot ordinary table salt at houseflies and insects, range about 2-3 feet, some with CO2 cartridge or laser sight; no pesticide and not comparable to air guns.

Soft padded textile sensory activity toys for infants and toddlers (fold-out 'soft books' with crinkle interior, teething rings, mirror, detachable plush characters and Velcro tabs for strollers), for children under 3.
rulings.note: Despite being called 'books' they are not bound multi-page books; classified as toys.

rulings.description: Children's 7-inch plush stuffed ladybug toy with embroidered eyes and mouth and stuffed wings, designed for children 3 years and older.

Direct-drive racing simulator kit for PC: steering wheel, wheel base, pedals, desk clamp, power adapter and USB cable, used as game controller peripherals for racing video games; no game content or computing unit.
Card game 'White Rabbit' consisting of a deck of 40 cards for 3 to 6 players aged 8 and up.
rulings.note: Same ruling puts the dice game and board games in 9504.90.6000; only the card game is recorded here.

rulings.description: Aluminum clamp-on adapter that mounts to a stationary exercise bicycle and accepts a standard bicycle stem so regular bicycle handlebars can be fitted for indoor training.
rulings.note: Accessory solely for exercise cycles.

rulings.description: Golf-themed backyard target games with oversized adjustable plastic golf club, turf tee mat, foam balls and fabric/net targets with scoring areas, used as outdoor recreational games.
rulings.note: Close call: not board games of 9504.90 and not golf equipment of 9506.39; outdoor games of 9506.99.

rulings.description: Scuba diving mask (tempered glass lens, silicone skirt, strap) with a built-in augmented-reality dive computer module showing depth, dive time and decompression data; sold with charging cradle and case.
rulings.note: Close call composite good: the diving mask, not the electronic dive computer (8543), gives essential character.

vague.why: Chemistry (lithium-ion, lead-acid, nickel-metal hydride, alkaline primary vs rechargeable), whether it is a single cell or a pack, and what it powers (vehicle, e-bike, phone, tool).

Knit or woven fabric, fiber content by weight (cotton, man-made fibers, wool), men's/boys' vs women's/girls', and garment features (collar, front opening, sleeves) to separate shirts, blouses, T-shirts and sweatshirts.
What machine or vehicle the parts are for, what the part is and does, material, and whether it is a general-use fastener or fitting (Section XV) or a dedicated part.
What the machine does (its principal function), how it is powered, whether it is household or industrial, and the goods it processes.

Type of bag (handbag, backpack, tote, wallet, case for a specific device, packing sack), the outer-surface material (leather, plastic sheeting, textile with fiber type, molded plastic), and whether it is insulated.
Material of the upper and of the outer sole that contacts the ground, whether it covers the ankle, athletic or not, men's/women's, and value per pair.
Whether it is a complete luminaire, a lamp/bulb or LED module, a part such as a shade, or a signaling indicator; where it is used (table, ceiling, outdoor, vehicle) and its material.
What the toy is (plush, game, ride-on, video game accessory), the intended age group (under 3 or 3-12), whether it is for pets, and whether it has a utilitarian function.
Form (bar, plate, tube, wire, fastener, structure, household article), whether threaded, the alloy (stainless vs carbon), and the end use.
Type (seat, table, storage, bed), frame material (wood, metal, plastic, textile), upholstered or not, and household vs office or outdoor use.
The specific device and its principal function (data processing, telecommunication, audio, measuring), and whether wireless transmission is primary or incidental.
What the article is and how it is used (packing container, kitchenware, household article, apparel, building component), the type of plastic, and whether other materials are present.
Which vehicle system the part belongs to (brakes, suspension, body, engine), its material, and whether it is for passenger cars, trucks, motorcycles or bicycles.
Woven, knit or nonwoven; fiber content percentages; weight per square meter; whether coated, laminated or quilted; and whether it is in the piece or a made-up article.
What it measures or does (diagnostic, therapeutic, instrument, wearable sensor), whether it is electrical, who uses it, and whether it is specially designed for persons with disabilities.
